A new voice joins our advisory board this spring.

Ruth Calder of Fenwick University joins the advisory board to advise on public sector reporting. Public sector bodies report energy use to more people than most, and the reports have to stand up to questions from every one of them. Ruth will help us keep Brightwell Analytics focused on what those bodies need from a monthly report. [Ruth's role title]

Please join us in welcoming Ruth, and follow along as the board gets to work.
